name: issue
query: issue(number:$number){id number title state stateReason body updatedAt repository{nameWithOwner} assignees(first:10){nodes{login}}
blockedBy(first:100){totalCount nodes{id number state stateReason repository{nameWithOwner}}}

subIssues(first:30){totalCount nodes{id number title state stateReason body updatedAt repository{nameWithOwner} assignees(first:10){nodes{login}} projectItems(first:100){nodes{id project{id} updatedAt status:fieldValueByName(name:"Status"){...on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue{name}} base:fieldValueByName(name:"Zielrelease"){...on ProjectV2ItemFieldSingleSelectValue{name} ...on ProjectV2ItemFieldTextValue{text}}}} blockedBy(first:100){totalCount nodes{id number state stateReason repository{nameWithOwner}}}}}

closedByPullRequestsReferences(first:100,includeClosedPrs:true){totalCount nodes{id number url state merged mergedAt body updatedAt isDraft isCrossRepository mergeStateStatus baseRefName headRefName headRefOid mergeCommit{oid} repository{nameWithOwner}}}}}}

name: pull-request
query: id url number state isDraft createdAt headRefName headRefOid baseRefName mergeStateStatus reviewDecision isCrossRepository headRepository{nameWithOwner} body bodyHTML mergeCommit{oid}
commits(last:1){nodes{commit{oid committedDate checkSuites(first:30){totalCount nodes{createdAt status conclusion app{slug} workflowRun{databaseId workflow{id}} checkRuns(first:1){totalCount}}}
...on CheckRun{name status conclusion title summary detailsUrl startedAt completedAt checkSuite{databaseId createdAt app{slug} workflowRun{databaseId event workflow{id name}}}}

requestEvents:timelineItems(last:100,itemTypes:[REVIEW_REQUESTED_EVENT]){totalCount nodes{...on ReviewRequestedEvent{createdAt requestedReviewer{...on User{login} ...on Bot{login} ...on Team{name}}}}}}}}

name: search
query: query($q:String!){viewer{login} search(query:$q,type:ISSUE_ADVANCED,first:30){issueCount pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor} nodes{...on Issue{id number title body updatedAt
assignees(first:10){nodes{login}} comments(last:10){nodes{createdAt url body}} labels(first:20){totalCount nodes{name}}
blockedBy(first:100){totalCount nodes{id number state stateReason repository{nameWithOwner}}}

closedByPullRequestsReferences(first:10,includeClosedPrs:true){totalCount nodes{id number url state body merged mergedAt updatedAt mergeStateStatus baseRefName headRefName headRefOid repository{nameWithOwner}}}

name: project-fields
query: id name options{id name} issueField{...on IssueFieldSingleSelect{id options{id name}}}}}}}}}

name: nodes
query: query{nodes(ids:$IDS){...on Issue{closedByPullRequestsReferences(first:10,includeClosedPrs:true){totalCount nodes{number state isDraft isCrossRepository repository{nameWithOwner} baseRefName headRefName headRefOid}}
...on PullRequest{id comments(last:5){nodes{createdAt url body}} reviews(last:5){nodes{createdAt url body}}}
